description: Trade-date, tenor and spot-roll inputs of an FX forward built from its trade date.

base_calendar_id.description: Base-currency holiday calendar id; `None` uses weekends only.

base_currency.description: Base (foreign) currency: the numerator of the quote and the notional currency.

business_day_convention.description:
Business-day convention rolling the maturity on the joint calendar.
`None` selects Modified Following, the ISDA FX settlement convention.

end_of_month.description:
Preserve month-end: a month-end spot date gives a month-end maturity.
Defaults to `false`.

quote_calendar_id.description: Quote-currency holiday calendar id; `None` uses weekends only.

quote_currency.description: Quote (domestic) currency: the denominator of the quote and the PV currency.

settlement_days.description:
T+N spot lag in business days (typically 2, or 1 for USD/CAD). `None`
selects the pair's market-standard lag from
[`finstack_quant_core::dates::fx::fx_standard_settlement_days`].

tenor.description: Calendar tenor from spot to maturity, e.g. `3M`.

trade_date.description: Trade date from which the spot date is rolled.

title: FxForwardTradeDateParams
